new: SpaleVoice now has accounts. You sign in once, and your licence follows you to any computer you install it on.
A licence screen that tells you who the licence is for, how many computers it covers, and which one you are on.
Updates now show you what changed before you download anything — this list.
The setup window has SpaleVoice's own frame instead of the plain Windows one.
fixed: The setup window ignored your light or dark choice and was always dark.
The setup window's close button is now part of the app, so it matches everything else.
gone: The old version that ran without a licence. 1.0.0 is retired and will not be offered again.

new: SpaleVoice sada ima naloge. Prijavite se jednom, i licenca vas prati na svaki računar na koji ga instalirate.
Ekran licence koji vam kaže na koga glasi, koliko računara pokriva i na kom ste trenutno.
Ažuriranja sada pokazuju šta se menja pre nego što bilo šta preuzmete — ovaj spisak.
Prozor za podešavanje ima SpaleVoice okvir umesto običnog Windows-ovog.
fixed: Prozor za podešavanje nije poštovao izbor svetle ili tamne teme i uvek je bio taman.
Dugme za zatvaranje tog prozora je sada deo aplikacije, pa se uklapa sa ostatkom.
gone: Stara verzija koja je radila bez licence. 1.0.0 je povučena i više se neće nuditi.

new: SpaleVoice 现在有账户了。登录一次，授权就会跟着你到任何一台安装它的电脑上。
新增授权页面，显示授权归谁、覆盖几台电脑，以及你当前在哪一台上。
更新现在会在下载之前告诉你有什么变化 — 就是这份清单。
设置窗口用上了 SpaleVoice 自己的窗框，不再是普通的 Windows 样式。
fixed: 设置窗口此前忽略你选择的浅色或深色主题，始终显示深色。
设置窗口的关闭按钮现在属于应用本身，与其他部分保持一致。
gone: 没有授权检查的旧版本。1.0.0 已停用，不会再被提供。

new: Your account and licence are now in the tray menu, so you can open them whenever you like instead of finding out when you try to talk.
fixed: The tray menu now says plainly when you are not signed in, rather than looking the same either way.

new: Nalog i licenca su sada u meniju u sistemskoj traci, pa možete da ih otvorite kad hoćete umesto da saznate tek kad pokušate da pričate.
fixed: Meni u sistemskoj traci sada jasno kaže kada niste prijavljeni, umesto da izgleda isto u oba slučaja.

new: 账户和授权现在放进了托盘菜单，你随时可以打开，不必等到开口说话时才发现。
fixed: 托盘菜单现在会明确显示你尚未登录，而不是两种情况看起来完全一样。

new: If SpaleVoice ever falls over, it now asks what you were doing and lets you leave an email, so there is a way to write back to you.
You can report a problem at any time from the tray menu, even when nothing has crashed.
A report that cannot be sent — no internet, say — is kept and offered again next time you open the app, so it is never lost.
fixed: When the part of the app that listens to your microphone died, dictation just quietly stopped working until you restarted. Now you are told.

new: Ako se SpaleVoice sruši, sada vas pita šta ste radili i možete ostaviti imejl, pa ima načina da vam se odgovori.
Problem možete prijaviti kad god hoćete iz menija u sistemskoj traci, i kada se ništa nije srušilo.
Prijava koja ne može da se pošalje — recimo bez interneta — čuva se i biće ponuđena sledeći put kad otvorite program, tako da se ne gubi.
fixed: Kada bi otkazao deo programa koji sluša mikrofon, diktiranje bi samo tiho prestalo da radi dok ne restartujete. Sada vam se javi.

new: 如果 SpaleVoice 崩溃了，它现在会问你当时在做什么，你也可以留下邮箱，这样我们能回复你。
任何时候都可以从托盘菜单反馈问题，即使什么都没崩溃。
发不出去的报告（比如没网）会被保留，下次打开时再次提示，不会丢失。
fixed: 以前负责听麦克风的那部分一旦出问题，口述就会悄无声息地失效，直到你重启。现在它会告诉你。

new: You can send a suggestion any time — there is a button in the top corner of Settings, a Feedback section at the bottom of it, and an entry in the tray menu.
Once in a long while, after you have used SpaleVoice enough to have an opinion, it will ask whether there is anything you would change. Never while you are dictating.
That question comes with Later and Don't ask again, and Don't ask again is honoured for good — though you can turn it back on in Settings if you change your mind.
fixed: Reporting a problem no longer offers to restart the app, which made no sense when nothing had crashed.

new: Predlog možete poslati kad god hoćete — dugme je u gornjem uglu Settings-a, sekcija Feedback je na dnu, a postoji i stavka u meniju u sistemskoj traci.
S vremena na vreme, kada budete koristili SpaleVoice dovoljno da imate mišljenje, pitaće vas ima li nešto što biste promenili. Nikada dok diktirate.
To pitanje ima i Kasnije i Ne pitaj me više, a Ne pitaj me više se poštuje zauvek — mada možete da ga vratite u Settings-u ako se predomislite.
fixed: Prijava problema više ne nudi restart programa, što nije imalo smisla kada se ništa nije srušilo.

new: 你随时都可以提建议 — 设置页右上角有个按钮，底部有「反馈」一节，托盘菜单里也有。
偶尔一次，等你用得足够多、有了看法之后，它会问你有没有想改的地方。绝不会在你口述的时候打扰。
这个提问带有「以后再说」和「不要再问我」，后者会被永久遵守 — 不过你改主意的话，可以在设置里重新打开。
fixed: 反馈问题时不再提示重启应用 — 什么都没崩溃的时候，那个按钮毫无意义。

new: Setup can be walked backwards. There is a back arrow in the title bar, opposite the close button, on every step but the first.
SpaleVoice finally looks like itself in the taskbar and in Task Manager, with its own icon and its own name instead of Electron's.
fixed: Without a licence the program now stays shut. Listening, the floating cloud and the settings are held back until you sign in — and signing in, sending a suggestion and reporting a problem stay reachable the whole time.
The licence panel said ACCOUNT.STATUS.SIGNED_OUT where a sentence belonged, and painted "not signed in" red as though something had broken.
gone: Being able to close the setup window and use the rest of the program anyway.

new: Kroz podešavanje se sada može i unazad. Strelica je u naslovnoj traci, naspram dugmeta za zatvaranje, na svakom koraku osim prvog.
SpaleVoice konačno izgleda kao svoj u taskbaru i u Task Manageru — sopstvena ikonica i sopstveno ime, umesto Electronovog.
fixed: Bez licence program sada stoji zatvoren. Slušanje, plutajući oblak i podešavanja čekaju da se prijavite — a prijava, slanje predloga i prijava problema ostaju dostupni sve vreme.
U panelu licence je pisalo ACCOUNT.STATUS.SIGNED_OUT umesto rečenice, a „niste prijavljeni" je bilo crveno kao da se nešto pokvarilo.
gone: Mogućnost da zatvorite prozor za podešavanje pa ipak koristite ostatak programa.

new: 设置流程现在可以往回走。标题栏里有一个返回箭头，与关闭按钮相对，除第一步外每一步都有。
SpaleVoice 在任务栏和任务管理器里终于是它自己了——自己的图标和名称，不再是 Electron 的。
fixed: 没有授权时，程序现在是锁住的。听写、悬浮气泡和设置都要等你登录之后才开放——而登录、提交建议和反馈问题始终可用。
授权面板本该显示一句话，却显示成 ACCOUNT.STATUS.SIGNED_OUT，并且把「未登录」标成红色，像是出了故障。
gone: 关掉设置窗口之后照样使用其余功能的做法。

new: You can throw away what you are saying. Press Escape while dictating and the whole thing goes — the words still being recognised and the ones already typed. You can change the key in Settings under Hotkeys.
The bubble can be any size. Three sizes to pick from, or drag the slider for anything in between; it resizes while you drag so you can see what you are choosing.
fixed: An update no longer opens a window over whatever you were doing. It arrives as a notification from the tray, and the list of changes opens only if you click it. A required update still shows straight away.
When an update finished downloading it used to put a dialog box in front of you, mid-sentence. Now it waits quietly in the tray.

new: Možete da bacite ono što govorite. Pritisnete Escape usred diktata i nestaje sve — i reči koje se još prepoznaju i one koje su već otkucane. Taster se menja u Podešavanjima, pod Prečice.
Oblak može da bude koje god veličine hoćete. Tri ponuđene, ili klizač za sve između; menja se dok vučete, pa vidite šta birate.
fixed: Ažuriranje više ne otvara prozor preko onoga što radite. Stiže kao obaveštenje iz trake sa alatkama, a spisak izmena se otvara samo ako kliknete. Obavezno ažuriranje se i dalje prikazuje odmah.
Kad se ažuriranje preuzme, ranije vam je iskakao prozor nasred rečenice. Sada čeka mirno u traci.

new: 你可以丢掉正在说的内容。听写途中按 Escape，整段都会消失——还在识别的词，以及已经打出来的词。按键可以在设置的快捷键里更改。
悬浮气泡可以是任意大小。三种预设，或者拖动滑块选择之间的任何尺寸；拖动时实时变化，所见即所得。
fixed: 更新不再在你做事时弹出窗口。它现在以托盘通知的形式出现，点击才会打开更新内容列表。必需的更新仍会立即显示。
更新下载完成后，过去会在你打字时弹出对话框。现在它安静地待在托盘里。

new: A What's new section in Settings: every version and what changed in it, in your language.
Decide straight from the notification — Update now, or Later. Update now downloads and installs on its own.
fixed: Updates now arrive on their own, without waiting for a restart.
A required update installs itself instead of waiting to be clicked.
gone: All older installers. They can no longer be downloaded, which is why this update is required.

new: Odeljak „What's new" u Podešavanjima: svaka verzija i šta je u njoj promenjeno, na vašem jeziku.
Odlučite odmah iz obaveštenja — sada ili kasnije. „Sada" se preuzme i instalira samo.
fixed: Ažuriranja sada stižu sama, bez čekanja na restart.
Obavezno ažuriranje se instalira samo, ne čeka klik.
gone: Svi stariji instalateri. Više se ne mogu preuzeti, i zato je ovo ažuriranje obavezno.

new: 设置里新增「What's new」：每个版本以及各自的改动，用你的语言显示。
直接在通知里决定——立即更新，或稍后。立即更新会自行下载并安装。
fixed: 更新现在会自动送达，不必等到重启。
必需的更新会自行安装，不再等待点击。
gone: 所有旧版安装包。它们已无法下载，这也是本次更新为必需的原因。

new: SpaleVoice can now run a model on your own computer. Settings shows what your machine can handle, downloads the one you pick with a progress figure, and transcribes without sending your voice anywhere or costing anything per minute.
Setup asks where to install. If you already have SpaleVoice, it goes where it already is and does not ask.
fixed: Setup stops with an explanation on a computer that cannot run SpaleVoice, instead of installing and failing on first launch.

new: SpaleVoice sada može da radi na modelu koji stoji na vašem računaru. U Podešavanjima piše šta vaša mašina može da povuče, preuzima izabrani model uz prikaz procenta, i prepisuje bez slanja glasa bilo gde i bez troška po minutu.
Podešavanje pita gde da instalira. Ako već imate SpaleVoice, ide tamo gde već stoji i ne pita.
fixed: Podešavanje staje uz objašnjenje na računaru koji ne može da pokrene SpaleVoice, umesto da se instalira pa da pukne pri prvom pokretanju.

new: SpaleVoice 现在可以使用你自己电脑上的模型。设置里会显示你的机器能带动什么，下载时显示进度百分比，转写过程不会把你的声音发送到任何地方，也不按分钟计费。
安装程序会询问安装位置。如果你已经装过 SpaleVoice，它会直接装在原来的位置，不再询问。
fixed: 在无法运行 SpaleVoice 的电脑上，安装程序会给出说明并停止，而不是装完之后在首次启动时失败。

new: Forgotten your password? Ask for a code, type the six digits from the email, and set a new one — all inside SpaleVoice.
If you already have a Whisper model on your computer, SpaleVoice finds it and uses it. No second download of a file you have.
Setup now says which service each model bills to, and asks for the ElevenLabs key only if you pick Scribe.
fixed: Notifications appear only when there is actually an update.

new: Zaboravili ste lozinku? Zatražite kod, ukucajte šest cifara iz imejla i postavite novu — sve unutar SpaleVoice-a.
Ako već imate Whisper model na računaru, SpaleVoice ga pronađe i koristi. Bez ponovnog preuzimanja fajla koji imate.
Podešavanje sada kaže kod koga se svaki model naplaćuje, i traži ElevenLabs ključ samo ako izaberete Scribe.
fixed: Obaveštenja se javljaju samo kada zaista postoji ažuriranje.

new: 忘记密码？申请验证码，输入邮件里的六位数字，然后设置新密码——全部在 SpaleVoice 里完成。
如果你的电脑上已经有 Whisper 模型，SpaleVoice 会找到并直接使用，不会重复下载你已有的文件。
安装设置现在会说明每个模型由哪家服务计费，只有选择 Scribe 时才会索取 ElevenLabs 密钥。
fixed: 只有真的有更新时才会弹出通知。

new: Accounts confirm their email address. A six-digit code arrives by email and you type it into SpaleVoice — no links, no browser.
Existing accounts confirm once as well, the next time they sign in.
Nalozi sada potvrđuju imejl adresu. Šestocifreni kod stigne na mejl i ukucate ga u SpaleVoice — bez linkova i bez pregledača.
Postojeći nalozi to urade jednom, pri sledećoj prijavi.
账户现在需要确认邮箱地址。六位验证码会发到邮箱，在 SpaleVoice 里输入即可——没有链接，也不用浏览器。
已有账户在下次登录时也确认一次。

fixed: The confirmation screen now sends the code it says it sent, so signing in to an unconfirmed account no longer waits on a button.
Ekran za potvrdu sada zaista pošalje kod koji najavljuje, pa prijava na nepotvrđen nalog više ne čeka da pritisnete dugme.
确认页面现在会真正发送它所说的验证码，登录未确认的账户不再需要先点按钮。

new: Put a picture on your account. It shows up in every Spale program you sign in to.
Reporting a problem? Attach a screenshot. "It looked like this" says more than a paragraph, and the picture is encrypted before it leaves your computer.
Skipped a few versions? The update now lists everything you are getting, not only the newest release.
fixed: An account that has not confirmed its address can no longer keep using SpaleVoice on an old session.

new: Stavite sliku na nalog. Vidi se u svakom Spale programu u koji se njime prijavite.
Prijavljujete problem? Zakačite sliku ekrana. „Ovako je izgledalo" kaže više od pasusa, a slika se šifruje pre nego što napusti vaš računar.
Preskočili ste par verzija? Ažuriranje sada nabraja sve što dobijate, ne samo poslednje izdanje.
fixed: Nalog koji nije potvrdio adresu više ne može da nastavi da koristi SpaleVoice na staroj sesiji.

new: 给账户设置头像。你登录的每一个 Spale 程序都会显示它。
反馈问题时可以附上截图。「当时是这样」胜过一整段描述，而且图片在离开你的电脑之前就已加密。
跳过了几个版本？更新现在会列出你将获得的全部内容，而不只是最新一版。
fixed: 未确认邮箱地址的账户，不能再凭旧会话继续使用 SpaleVoice。
Confirming your email now asks for the six-digit code, instead of a licence key you do not need.
Potvrda imejla sada traži šestocifreni kod, umesto licencnog ključa koji vam ne treba.
确认邮箱时现在要求输入六位验证码，而不是你并不需要的授权密钥。
Updating no longer asks where to install. It installs where SpaleVoice already is and reopens itself.
Ažuriranje više ne pita gde da instalira. Instalira se tamo gde SpaleVoice već stoji i samo se ponovo otvori.
更新不再询问安装位置。它会装在 SpaleVoice 原本所在的位置，并自动重新打开。

new: See which computers are using your licence, and remove one yourself. One a month — enough for a reinstall or a new laptop.
fixed: Signing out now closes SpaleVoice properly instead of leaving the settings open and usable.

new: Vidite koji računari koriste vašu licencu i sami sklonite jedan. Jedan mesečno — dovoljno za reinstalaciju ili novi laptop.
fixed: Odjava sada zaista zatvara SpaleVoice, umesto da ostavi podešavanja otvorena i upotrebljiva.

new: 查看哪些电脑在使用你的授权，并自行移除其中一台。每月一次——足够应付重装系统或换新笔记本。
fixed: 退出登录现在会真正关闭 SpaleVoice，而不是让设置窗口继续开着并可用。

new: The setup file deletes itself once it has finished. No leftover installer in Downloads waiting to be double-clicked a year from now.
Instalacioni fajl se sam obriše kad završi. Nema zaostalog setupa u Preuzimanjima koji čeka da ga za godinu dana neko dvaput klikne.
安装程序完成后会自动删除自己。下载文件夹里不会再留下一个一年后被误双击的旧安装包。
A new computer asks before it joins your licence. You get a code by email, and you can see how many places are taken before you decide.
Once a month SpaleVoice checks it is still you. One code, ten seconds, and only on computers left signed in.
"Keep me signed in" — leave it off on a computer that is not yours and SpaleVoice forgets you when it closes.
Remove a computer you no longer use, from inside the app. Twice a month, which covers a reinstall or a new laptop.
gone: Computers quietly adding themselves to your licence without asking.

new: Novi računar pita pre nego što se doda na vašu licencu. Kod stiže na mejl, a pre odluke vidite koliko je mesta zauzeto.
Jednom mesečno SpaleVoice proveri da ste to i dalje vi. Jedan kod, deset sekundi, i to samo na računarima koji ostaju prijavljeni.
„Ostani prijavljen" — isključite na tuđem računaru i SpaleVoice vas zaboravi čim se zatvori.
Sklonite računar koji više ne koristite, iz same aplikacije. Dvaput mesečno, što pokriva reinstalaciju ili novi laptop.
gone: Računari koji su se tiho dodavali na vašu licencu bez pitanja.

new: 新电脑加入你的授权前会先询问。验证码发到邮箱，决定之前你能看到已占用几个名额。
每月一次，SpaleVoice 确认仍是你本人。一个验证码，十秒钟，只针对保持登录的电脑。
「保持登录」——在不属于你的电脑上关掉它，SpaleVoice 关闭时就会忘记你。
在应用内移除不再使用的电脑。每月两次，足够应付重装或换新笔记本。
gone: 电脑不经询问就悄悄加入你的授权。

fixed: Closing SpaleVoice is no longer mistaken for a crash. The crash window appears when something actually breaks.
Sending a report now sends the ones that were waiting behind it, so it does not keep asking again.
Zatvaranje SpaleVoice-a se više ne shvata kao pad. Prozor za prijavu iskače kad se nešto stvarno pokvari.
Slanje prijave sada šalje i one koje su čekale iza nje, pa ne pita iznova.
关闭 SpaleVoice 不再被误判为崩溃。崩溃窗口只在真正出问题时出现。
发送一份报告时，排在后面等待的报告会一并发出，不会再反复询问。

new: The licence pane says which licence you are using. Entering a different key shows you what you gain and what you give up, and asks before it changes anything.
If the recorder ever dies, SpaleVoice brings it back by itself instead of going quiet until you restart it.
fixed: Closing SpaleVoice is no longer reported as a crash, however it is closed.

new: Panel licence sada piše koju licencu koristite. Kad unesete drugi ključ, prvo vidite šta dobijate a šta gubite, pa se tek onda pita.
Ako snimač ikad otkaže, SpaleVoice ga sam vrati umesto da ućuti dok ga ne restartujete.
fixed: Zatvaranje SpaleVoice-a se više ne prijavljuje kao pad, na koji god način da se zatvori.

new: 授权面板会显示你正在使用哪一个授权。输入另一个密钥时，会先告诉你得到什么、失去什么，然后才询问是否更换。
录音组件万一停止工作，SpaleVoice 会自行恢复，而不是一直沉默到你重启。
fixed: 关闭 SpaleVoice 不再被报告为崩溃，无论以何种方式关闭。

new: Your licence and your account live in SpaleHub now — one place for every Spale program. Install SpaleHub, sign in there, and SpaleVoice unlocks itself.
Updates come through SpaleHub as well, so there is one thing to keep current instead of several.
fixed: The update window could not be minimised.
gone: The sign-in and licence screens inside SpaleVoice. They are in SpaleHub.

new: Licenca i nalog su sada u SpaleHub-u — jedno mesto za sve Spale programe. Instalirajte SpaleHub, prijavite se tamo, i SpaleVoice se sam otključava.
Ažuriranja takođe idu kroz SpaleHub, pa se održava jedna stvar umesto više njih.
fixed: Prozor za ažuriranje nije mogao da se minimizuje.
gone: Ekrani za prijavu i licencu unutar SpaleVoice-a. Sada su u SpaleHub-u.

new: 您的授权和账户现在都在 SpaleHub 中 — 所有 Spale 程序共用一处。安装 SpaleHub 并登录，SpaleVoice 就会自动解锁。
更新也通过 SpaleHub 进行，只需保持一个程序为最新即可。
fixed: 更新窗口无法最小化。
gone: SpaleVoice 内部的登录和授权界面，它们已移至 SpaleHub。

new: Both API keys have their own permanent field in Settings — OpenAI for GPT Transcribe, ElevenLabs for Scribe v2. Each is kept on its own, so switching between the two models never means typing a key again.
fixed: The ElevenLabs key could only be entered while Scribe was already the selected model, so setting it meant switching model, pasting, and switching back.

new: Oba API ključa imaju svoje stalno polje u podešavanjima — OpenAI za GPT Transcribe, ElevenLabs za Scribe v2. Svaki se čuva zasebno, pa prelazak sa jednog modela na drugi više ne znači ponovno kucanje ključa.
fixed: ElevenLabs ključ se mogao uneti samo dok je Scribe već bio izabran model, pa je za njegovo postavljanje trebalo prebaciti model, nalepiti, pa vratiti nazad.

new: 两个 API 密钥在设置中各有固定的输入框——OpenAI 用于 GPT Transcribe，ElevenLabs 用于 Scribe v2。两者分别保存，在模型之间切换时不必再重新输入密钥。
fixed: 以前只有在已经选中 Scribe 时才能填写 ElevenLabs 密钥，因此设置它需要先切换模型、粘贴，然后再切回来。

new: SpaleVoice opens its window when it starts, not just the floating bubble — so the model, what you have spent and whether it is listening are there without hunting for them. If you have set it to launch minimized with Windows, it still comes up quietly.

SpaleVoice pri pokretanju otvara i svoj prozor, ne samo plutajući bubble — pa su model, potrošnja i to da li sluša odmah pred tobom. Ako si podesio da se diže minimizovan uz Windows, i dalje se pokreće tiho.
SpaleVoice 启动时会打开自己的窗口，而不只是悬浮气泡——模型、已用花费以及是否正在聆听都一目了然。如果你设置了随 Windows 最小化启动，它仍会安静地启动。

Noise suppression is now SpaleVoice's own, with three settings instead of a switch. Off is raw audio and still the best a quiet room can give the model; Light takes out steady hum, fans and hiss; Strong is for a genuinely noisy room. It runs on the finished sentence, on your computer, and costs nothing.

A desk bump, a keyboard click or a cough no longer counts as something you said. SpaleVoice now listens in the band where speech actually lives, so noise stops opening the microphone — and anything that opens it without a word in it is thrown away before it is ever sent.
fixed: Remove filler words no longer eats real words. It was deleting "um" out of Serbian sentences where it means mind, and "ovaj" where it means this — so "ovaj čovek je došao" came back missing its subject. Words that are only sometimes filler now go only when you actually paused around them.

Removing a filler no longer leaves the punctuation behind it. "Um, I think so." used to become ", I think so." — a leading comma and a lowercase sentence. A phrase that was nothing but hesitation now types nothing at all, instead of a lone full stop.
A loud noise no longer leaves the microphone deaf. One cough used to raise the bar for what counted as speech and there was no way back down short of stopping and starting again.
gone: The Mic noise suppression switch, which turned on the browser's own call-tuned processing. It was built to make a phone call intelligible, not to help a transcription model, and it cost accuracy either way it was set. If you had it on, you now have Light.

new: Uklanjanje šuma je sada SpaleVoice-ovo sopstveno, sa tri nivoa umesto prekidača. Isključeno je sirov zvuk i i dalje najbolje što tiha soba može da da modelu; Blago skida stalan šum, ventilatore i šuštanje; Jako je za zaista bučnu sobu. Radi nad gotovom rečenicom, na tvom računaru, i ne košta ništa.

Udarac o sto, klik tastature ili kašalj više se ne računaju kao nešto što si rekao. SpaleVoice sada sluša u opsegu u kome govor zaista živi, pa šum više ne otvara mikrofon — a sve što ga otvori bez ijedne reči baca se pre nego što se uopšte pošalje.
fixed: Uklanjanje poštapalica više ne jede prave reči. Brisalo je „um“ iz srpskih rečenica gde znači razum, i „ovaj“ gde je pokazna zamenica — pa se „ovaj čovek je došao“ vraćalo bez subjekta. Reči koje su samo ponekad poštapalice sada odlaze samo kad si oko njih stvarno zastao.

Uklanjanje poštapalice više ne ostavlja interpunkciju za sobom. „Ovaj, mislim da jeste.“ postajalo je „, mislim da jeste.“ — zarez na početku i mala slova. Iskaz koji je bio samo oklevanje sada ne ukuca ništa, umesto usamljene tačke.
Glasan zvuk više ne ostavlja mikrofon gluvim. Jedan kašalj je dizao prag za ono što se broji kao govor, i nije bilo povratka osim da zaustaviš i ponovo pokreneš.
gone: Prekidač „Mic noise suppression“, koji je uključivao browser-ovu obradu pravljenu za pozive. Napravljena je da telefonski razgovor bude razgovetan, ne da pomogne modelu za prepoznavanje, i koštala je tačnosti kako god da je bila podešena. Ako si ga imao uključenog, sada imaš Blago.

new: 降噪现在由 SpaleVoice 自己完成，用三档取代了开关。关闭即原始音频，安静房间里这仍是能给模型的最好素材；轻度可去除稳定的嗡嗡声、风扇声和嘶声；强力用于确实嘈杂的房间。它在整句完成后于你的电脑上运行，不产生任何费用。
撞桌子、敲键盘或咳嗽不再被当作你说的话。SpaleVoice 现在只在语音真正存在的频段上聆听，噪音不再打开麦克风——任何打开了却没有一个词的片段，在发送之前就被丢弃。
fixed: 移除口头禅不再吃掉真正的词。它曾从塞尔维亚语句子中删掉表示「心智」的 um，以及作指示代词的 ovaj，于是「ovaj čovek je došao」回来时少了主语。只有在你确实在其前后停顿时，那些有时才是口头禅的词才会被移除。
移除口头禅不再留下它身后的标点。「Um, I think so.」曾变成「, I think so.」——句首一个逗号加小写开头。整句只是犹豫时，现在什么都不会输入，而不是一个孤零零的句号。
巨大的声响不再让麦克风失聪。一次咳嗽曾抬高「算作语音」的门槛，除了停止再重新开始别无办法。
gone: 「Mic noise suppression」开关，它启用的是浏览器为通话调校的处理。它的目标是让电话听得清楚，而不是帮助转录模型，无论开关如何设置都会损失准确度。如果你之前打开了它，现在你得到的是「轻度」。

fixed: ElevenLabs Scribe and the models you keep on your own computer can now actually start. SpaleVoice asked for an OpenAI key before it would open the microphone — whichever model you had chosen — so Scribe refused to run for anyone who had pasted an ElevenLabs key in the box below it, and a model that never sends your voice anywhere was held behind paying a vendor to do nothing. It now asks for the key the model you picked actually needs, and says which one that is when it is missing.

Nothing raises an alarm about a key your model does not want any more. The status light no longer reads "No key", and the OpenAI row in Settings no longer shows a red warning, when you are running Scribe or a model on this computer.
The model box no longer goes blank while a model on this computer is the one doing the work. It says which one it is.

A model on this computer cannot be selected before the speech engine that runs it has been downloaded. It could be, and then the app reported itself ready, opened the microphone, and only failed once you had finished speaking.

Dictations transcribed on this computer are counted in the readout. It used to say "nothing transcribed yet" to somebody who had been dictating all afternoon — the spend stays at zero, because that is the truth about a model that never left your machine.

ElevenLabs Scribe i modeli koje držiš na svom računaru sada zaista mogu da se pokrenu. SpaleVoice je tražio OpenAI ključ pre nego što uopšte otvori mikrofon — bez obzira koji si model izabrao — pa Scribe nije radio nikome ko je ElevenLabs ključ nalepio u polje ispod njega, a model koji tvoj glas nikuda i ne šalje bio je zaključan iza plaćanja nekome ko ništa ne radi. Sada traži ključ koji izabranom modelu stvarno treba, i kaže koji je to kad nedostaje.

Ništa više ne diže uzbunu zbog ključa koji tvom modelu ne treba. Statusna lampica više ne piše „No key“, a red za OpenAI u podešavanjima više ne svetli crveno, kada koristiš Scribe ili model sa ovog računara.
Polje za model više ne ostaje prazno dok posao radi model sa ovog računara. Sada piše koji je.
Model sa ovog računara ne može da se izabere pre nego što se preuzme program koji ga pokreće. Moglo je — pa se aplikacija javljala kao spremna, otvarala mikrofon, i pucala tek kad završiš rečenicu.

Diktati prepisani na ovom računaru se broje u prikazu. Ranije je pisalo „ništa još nije prepisano“ nekome ko diktira celo popodne — potrošnja ostaje nula, jer to je istina o modelu koji nikada nije napustio tvoju mašinu.

ElevenLabs Scribe 以及保存在你自己电脑上的模型现在真的可以启动了。此前无论你选了哪个模型，SpaleVoice 都要求先有 OpenAI 密钥才肯打开麦克风——于是把 ElevenLabs 密钥填在下方输入框里的人无法使用 Scribe，而一个根本不会把你的声音发送到任何地方的模型，却被挡在向某个服务商付费的门槛之后。现在它只索取所选模型真正需要的那把密钥，缺少时也会说明是哪一把。
不再为你的模型并不需要的密钥拉响警报。使用 Scribe 或本机模型时，状态灯不再显示「No key」，设置里的 OpenAI 那一行也不再显示红色警告。
当真正在工作的是本机模型时，模型选择框不再是空白，而会写明是哪一个。
在运行模型所需的语音引擎下载完成之前，本机模型无法被选中。此前可以选中，于是应用自称就绪、打开麦克风，直到你说完才失败。
在本机转录的听写会计入统计。此前对一个整个下午都在听写的人，它仍显示「尚未转录任何内容」——花费保持为零，因为这才是一个从未离开你机器的模型的真实情况。

new: SpaleVoice activates itself. If SpaleHub is on this computer and your licence is active, SpaleVoice now asks it for a fresh activation on its own — quietly, in the tray, with no window and nothing for you to press. It used to put a window in front of you asking you to go and sign in to a program you were already signed in to.
fixed: The SpaleHub window no longer sits there after the problem has been solved. It watched whether SpaleHub was installed, which stops being the question the moment it is — so it went on saying "sign in there" to somebody who had signed in, with an active licence and the activation already on disk. It now watches the licence itself, and closes the moment SpaleVoice is allowed to run.

A licence that needs renewing no longer interrupts you first and fixes itself second. SpaleVoice gives SpaleHub twenty seconds to sort it out before showing you anything, and only says something if that did not work — which is the only time there is anything for you to do.

new: SpaleVoice se sam aktivira. Ako je SpaleHub na ovom računaru i licenca je aktivna, SpaleVoice sada sam zatraži svežu aktivaciju — tiho, u tray-u, bez prozora i bez ijednog klika. Ranije ti je izbacivao prozor sa molbom da se prijaviš u program u koji si već bio prijavljen.
fixed: SpaleHub prozor više ne stoji otvoren kad je problem već rešen. Gledao je da li je SpaleHub instaliran, a to prestaje da bude pitanje čim jeste — pa je i dalje pisao „prijavi se tamo“ nekome ko je prijavljen, sa aktivnom licencom i aktivacijom koja je već na disku. Sada gleda samu licencu i zatvara se čim SpaleVoice sme da radi.

Licenca kojoj treba obnova više te ne prekida prvo pa se rešava drugo. SpaleVoice da SpaleHub-u dvadeset sekundi da to sredi pre nego što ti bilo šta pokaže, i javlja se samo ako nije uspelo — a to je jedini put kada zaista imaš šta da uradiš.

new: SpaleVoice 会自行激活。如果这台电脑上装有 SpaleHub 且你的授权处于有效状态，SpaleVoice 现在会自己去申请一份新的激活凭据——安静地在托盘中完成，没有窗口，也不需要你点任何东西。此前它会弹出一个窗口，请你去登录一个你早已登录的程序。
fixed: 问题解决之后，SpaleHub 窗口不会再一直停在那里。它此前只关注 SpaleHub 是否已安装，而一旦安装完成，这就不再是问题所在——于是它继续对一个已经登录、授权有效、激活凭据早已写入磁盘的人说「去那边登录」。现在它关注授权本身，并在 SpaleVoice 获准运行的那一刻关闭。
需要续期的授权不会再先打断你、后自我修复。SpaleVoice 会给 SpaleHub 二十秒去处理，之后才向你显示任何内容，并且只在没能成功时才开口——那也是唯一真正需要你动手的时候。
